Skip to main content Login Event Data Fika GBIF Sweden series Add to calendar 11 September 2026 – 4 June 2027 09:00–09:45 GMT+0 Online About Data Fika is a GBIF Sweden online webinar series for the Swedish biodiversity data community running from September 2026 to June 2027. Across ten sessions the series follows the biodiversity data journey from finding and reusing GBIF-mediated data to data quality standards metadata FAIR and CARE principles and publishing biodiversity data through GBIF. Four optional hands-on workshops provide opportunities for practical learning. The series is relevant to researchers data stewards students and others who work with biodiversity data and want to make better use of GBIF data tools standards and publishing infrastructure. Participants can attend individual sessions or follow the full series. How to join Participation is free and no preparation is needed. Send an email to lena.thole@nrm.se or gbif@nrm.se with Data Fika in the subject line to be added to the invitation list. Read more Location : Online When : Language : English

Skip to main content Login Event Ancestral wisdom and modern tools for conservation in the Amazon Add to calendar 15 September 2026 virtual This Spanish-language webinar will explore how traditional ecological knowledge and conservation technologies can work together to support community-led biodiversity monitoring in the Amazon. Drawing on processes, methods and case studies developed with communities in the Brazilian and Ecuadorian Amazon, Gabriel Nunes and Nicolás Schuldt Durán will discuss how local knowledge and technology can strengthen conservation outcomes while supporting community control over data and decision-making. The event is relevant to the GBIF community because it addresses the collection, stewardship and use of biodiversity data generated through community-led monitoring, as well as the importance of designing data practices that respond to local contexts and priorities. It will offer practical insights for people working on biodiversity monitoring, data mobilization, conservation technology and partnerships with Indigenous Peoples and local communities. This webinar is part of an ongoing series of virtual gatherings organized by the WILDLABS Latin America Community . Learn more Location : virtual When : Language : Spanish

Skip to main content Login Event National Biodiversity information Infrastructure and Data Mobilization in Lithuania Add to calendar 20 October 2026 Lithuania National Visitors Center of protected Areas, Vilnius This high-level meeting brings together policymakers, research institutions, museums, biodiversity data holders and international experts to discuss the development of Lithuania’s national biodiversity information infrastructure. Participants will examine the role of biodiversity data in policy and decision-making, the benefits of participation in GBIF and opportunities to improve national coordination, data access and alignment with European priorities. The meeting aims to identify concrete next steps towards sustainable biodiversity data mobilization and potential future GBIF participation. Project: CESP2025-002 Location : National Visitors Center of protected Areas, Vilnius Country or area : Lithuania When : Language : English
